displayDescription: Ideas and builders meet under one link rule; a baked, seeded run forms connected systems and the distribution bars shift as it happens.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, effects or narration.
limitations: Illustrative simulation: a seeded (seed 7), pre-baked 36-step rule run; counts are not measured data.
STYLE.json has no tech.preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so no reviewed recipe or source frames are shown; the preview shows the core Motion Graphic action.
Blender was not used. Flat 2D diagram drawn in Canvas 2D, with GSAP from the local gsap.min.js; no depth or lighting effects are needed for this medium.
The builder orange #D9622B comes from ILLUSTRATION.svg; the other colours follow the style's colour roles. The cool light background was picked to suit the scene.
